title: Topological and scheme-theoretic properties of the $D$-graded Proj construction
summary: We generalize the topological description of the $\mathbb{N}$-graded Proj construction to the multigraded Proj construction for factorially graded rings that are graded by finitely generated abelian groups $D$. However, there is one big structural difference: While the classical description is given by the space of homogeneous prime ideals not containing the irrelevant ideal, we characterize the multigraded Proj setting using $D$-prime ideals, i.e.\ ideals that have the prime property, but only for homogeneous factorizations.
